operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names (ethnicGroup, isMember, locatedOn, mergesWith, mountainOnIsland, geo_*) and mixed-case columns (Country1, Population_Growth, Infant_Mortality, SourceLongitude) — must be double-quoted verbatim.

FKs declared without explicit parent column (parent_col null) => parent column = child column name; e.g. borders.Country1/Country2 -> country.Code, city.Country -> province.Country AND country.Code (two FKs on same child col).

city has TWO FKs on Country (to province and to country) and one on Province (to province); located/locatedOn/organization have 5-8 FKs each, several sharing a child column (Province->province, Province->city; Country->province, Country->country).

Composite PKs everywhere: borders(Country1,Country2), city(Name,Province), encompasses(Country,Continent), geo_*(Province,Country,X), locatedOn(City,Province,Country,Island), mergesWith(Sea1,Sea2), province(Name,Country), language/religion/ethnicGroup(Name,Country).
Tables with NO primary key: islandIn, located — sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op; drop_unique_duplicates only applies to declared unique cols.

Self-referencing-ish: river.Lake -> lake.Name and lake.River -> river.Name (mutual FK between river and lake) — process_order must break the cycle deterministically; also river.River -> river.Name is a self-FK on the same table.
mountain table has 0 rows (empty parent) — mountainOnIsland.Mountain FK draws from empty parent => NULLs, but Mountain is NOT NULL => all rows fail insert; TS will produce an empty mountainOnIsland.

organization.Established and politics.Independence are declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g. '1974-02-18'); ts_fuzzer dispatches to Date|Number(int elements) — first element parses as int? no, so Date fuzzer with template %Y-%m-%d.
country.Name has UNIQUE constraint (ix_county_Name) and organization.Name has UNIQUE (ix_organization_OrgNameUnique) — drop_unique_duplicates will thin these tables.

country.Capital/Province null_rate 0.008, city.Longitude/Latitude null_rate 0.743, islandIn.River null_rate 0.997 (only value 'River'), located.Lake null_rate 0.942 — heavy NULL columns; TS Number/String samplers drop None elements so fresh draws dominate.
islandIn has no PK and 4 nullable FKs (Island,Sea,Lake,River) — every row is a fresh draw; no dedup.
All declared types are TEXT/REAL/INTEGER/DATE only — no BOOL/BIT/YEAR/CHAR(n)/VARCHAR(n) args, so Number scale=0 precision=0 for REAL/INTEGER, String length default 20.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer for all TEXT columns: 5 original samples + distinct literal-pool values, then w.p. p fresh random strings over 'a-zA-Z 0-9()' length 0-20, then 50% contaminate (suffix/prefix/around/drop-char). Country codes like 'AFG','A' will be replaced by random junk => joins on country.Code still work (FK consistency) but WHERE Code='AFG' style predicates miss.

Number fuzzer for REAL/INTEGER: scale=0 => range [-1,1] for REAL, [-1,1] for INTEGER (is_int), unsigned false; list range quirk sets upper end to full-range max => fresh draws are tiny floats in [-1,1] plus +-1/+-2 int perturbations. Population/Area/GDP values become ~0-2 => range predicates (Population > 1e6) return nothing => FN.

Date fuzzer for organization.Established / politics.Independence: template %Y-%m-%d from '1974-02-18' style; range = min..max of parsed elements; fresh dates uniform in that range; p=0.2 means 20% element reuse. Year-extraction queries (strftime('%Y',...)) plausible; but exact-date equality misses.

FK consistency: child FK columns draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement => many duplicate child rows; composite-PK tables (geo_*, locatedOn, encompasses) get PK-duplicate rows dropped, so effective row count << requested size.
Empty parent mountain => mountainOnIsland.Mountain all NULL => NOT NULL violation => 0 rows inserted; queries on mountainOnIsland return empty => FN.

Self-FK river.River -> river.Name: child draws from parent's already-generated Name column (same table, drawn earlier in column order) — plausible but river.River values are river names, not 'Rhein' style tributary names.
Mutual river<->lake FK: whichever table is level-0 gets fresh values, the other draws from it; lake.River and river.Lake become consistent but semantically swapped (lake.River = lake names).
country.Name UNIQUE + organization.Name UNIQUE: drop_unique_duplicates removes rows, so country/organization shrink below requested size; FK children then reference fewer parents.
islandIn (no PK, 4 nullable FKs): every row independent; Lake/River mostly NULL (parent draws from small sets, but null_rate 0.98/0.997 in original is not reproduced — TS draws non-null from parent).

String fuzzer on country.Code: 5 original codes + pool codes, then fresh random strings; FK children (economy.Country, encompasses.Country, etc.) draw from country.Code's final values => consistent but random 3-char junk; queries filtering Code IN ('USA','F','D') miss.
Number fuzzer on Percentage columns (encompasses, ethnicGroup, language, religion): range [-1,1] fresh draws => percentages outside [0,100] => SUM(Percentage) predicates and >50 filters miss.
No BOOL/BIT/YEAR columns; no crash-fallback types; no text-stored dates other than the two DATE columns; no storage-class contradictions (all REAL stored as real, INTEGER as integer, TEXT as text).
